title: Withdrawal of a Mortgage Pre-Approval or Pending Request
content:
Only the borrower can withdraw a Mortgage Pre-Approval or a pending request.

## Rule

Only the borrower can withdraw a pre-approval or a pending request; an agent asking to cancel it is referred to the borrower. Withdrawal voids every live letter and forfeits an unused rate hold fee.

A pre-approval withdrawn from requested or from issued status shows the status withdrawn, and its closed date is the date it reached withdrawn.

## Desk questions and answers

**Who can withdraw?**
The borrower, and only the borrower. This covers both a pre-approval already issued and a request still pending.

**A buyer's real estate agent asks for the pre-approval to be cancelled.**
The agent is referred to the borrower. The agent's request does not withdraw the pre-approval or the pending request.

**What happens to letters already issued?**
Withdrawal voids every live letter issued under the pre-approval.

**What happens to a Lock & Shop rate hold fee?**
Withdrawal forfeits an unused rate hold fee.

## At a glance

| Who asks to withdraw or cancel | Result |
|---|---|
| The borrower | the pre-approval or pending request is withdrawn; every live letter is voided; an unused rate hold fee is forfeited |
| A real estate agent | referred to the borrower |
